title: crypto2dev_cipher: same switch-on-cipher-type written twice
description: crypto2dev_cipher has two switch(info->cipher.type) blocks: the first sets aes/algo/iv/ivSz; the second (inside the data block) sets in_buf/out_buf/data_sz. The cases are the same, the logic is symmetric but split. A reader needs to mentally track two parallel switch trees to understand one operation. Suggested rewrite: introduce a single pass that sets all six variables together, or factor out a small inline struct that carries the per-algorithm pointers and pass it around.
